description: READ-PATH, index relocation. Writer a runs UPDATE T SET N = N + 1000000 (every entry of IX_N moves, dbFailOnError) on the idx fixture; b suspends a 40 ms after the start signal, confirms a had not returned, opens read-only and reads SUM/MIN/MAX of N, an IX_N cursor (first row, Seek N >= 20000, last row), then resumes a and reads again fresh after a pause. Asks whether a reader can see a mixed index and data state (some rows old, some moved), an error, or only the old state while the writer is frozen.
retentionNote: Designed r-q2-cat-txn-lock probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
